item.title: [AI & I by Every] How Every's Team Used AI to Ship Its Biggest Launch Ever
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:17 We generated the largest subscription revenue increase in Everest's history last week. We did it by launching this thing called the Builder Pack. Basically, we partnered with a bunch of the AI tools we use every day, and subscribers to the Builder Pack get discounts and credits to those tools. So thousand dollars in Codex credits, twelve months of free cursor access,
